weightings.description: Aggregate event magnitudes without temporal decay.

weightings.label: Persistent Exponential
weightings.description: Persistent memory with constant proportional transient forgetting.

weightings.description: Persistent memory with a smooth transition and a polynomial transient tail.

weightings.name: persistent_weibull
weightings.label: Persistent Weibull
weightings.description: Persistent memory with independently controlled transient scale and shape.
weightings.formula: phi(tau) = persistent_level + (1 - persistent_level) * exp(-(tau / scale) ** shape)
